_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV decroissante. Total sales en tete (top line), puis Americas (segment #1), EMEA, APAC, Engineering, OpProfit consolide.

kpis.signal: CA total LIN +3% en 2025, FX favorable +3% (EUR/GBP), prix +2%, volumes -2%, cost pass-through neutre
kpis.description_fr: CA total Linde (industrial gases). Leader mondial gaz industriels post-fusion Praxair-Linde AG 2018. Modele resilient via long-term contracts + cost pass-through.
kpis.description_en: Linde total sales (industrial gases). World leader post Praxair-Linde AG 2018 merger. Resilient model via long-term contracts + cost pass-through.

kpis.signal: Segment #1 LIN (~45% CA), exposition US gas industriel + helium + healthcare gas, croissance Gulf Coast
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Americas. Plus grand segment Linde. Historique FY21/FY22 non separe dans 10-K (donne en segment OP only).
kpis.description_en: Americas segment sales. Largest Linde segment. FY21/FY22 history not separately stated in 10-K (only segment OP given).

kpis.signal: OpProfit Americas +41% sur 4 ans, marge segment ~31% (4747/15208), levier pricing + productivite
kpis.description_fr: Resultat op. segment Americas. Marge ~31% en 2025. Cash machine principal LIN.
kpis.description_en: Americas segment operating profit. ~31% margin in 2025. LIN main cash engine.

kpis.signal: Forte croissance EMEA OpProfit +62% sur 4 ans, pricing power post-crise energie + helium
kpis.description_fr: Resultat op. segment EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa). Marge 36% (3055/8549). Levier prix dans contexte energie EU.
kpis.description_en: EMEA segment operating profit. 36% margin (3055/8549). Pricing leverage in EU energy context.

kpis.signal: APAC OpProfit stable 2025, decelerataion vs 2021-23 mais marge 29% (1933/6661) maintenue
kpis.description_fr: Resultat op. segment APAC (Asia-Pacific). Marge ~29%. Exposition semiconducteurs (Asie taiwanaise, Coree) + chimie chinoise.
kpis.description_en: APAC segment operating profit. ~29% margin. Exposure to semiconductors (Taiwan, Korea) + Chinese chemicals.

kpis.signal: Engineering segment plateau 2024-25, marge 18% sur 2250 M$ de CA, projets hydrogene en backlog
kpis.description_fr: Resultat op. segment Engineering (plant design/build hydrogene, clean energy). Indicateur leading capex futurs Linde gas industriel.
kpis.description_en: Engineering segment OP (plant design/build hydrogen, clean energy). Leading indicator for future Linde industrial gas capex.

kpis.signal: OpProfit consolide LIN 26.3% marge en 2025, expansion +10 bps vs 2024, hors charges PPA Linde AG
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel total (apres reconciliation cost reduction + PPA Linde AG -$941M). Marge OpProfit 26.3% 2025 vs 26.2% 2024.
kpis.description_en: Total operating profit (after reconciliation: cost reduction + Linde AG PPA -$941M). 26.3% OpProfit margin 2025 vs 26.2% 2024.
